choices.text: Venture deeper into the Whispering Woods, following the healthy glow.
Check back with your family at the campsite, explaining what you've seen.

segment.content:
The twilight air hums with the chirping of crickets and the distant hoot of an owl. Dew-kissed leaves rustle in the gentle breeze, carrying the scent of pine and damp earth. You, Hero, stir in your sleeping bag, the nylon cool against your cheek. The overnight camping trip your family planned feels a world away from the everyday hustle. You are nestled near the Whispering Woods, a place rumored to hold secrets as old as time. 

A faint, ethereal glow catches your eye. It pulses softly from the heart of the woods, an inviting beacon in the growing darkness. It’s a light unlike any you've seen before, not harsh or artificial, but something… magical. As you sit up, you notice the trees around you are adorned with tiny, luminous flowers. They weren't there when you went to sleep. These lumiflora, as you decide to call them, cast an otherworldly glow on the forest floor, lighting a path into the depths. But there’s a shadow in their midst. One patch of lumiflora is dim, almost…sickly. The air around it feels strangely cold.

This feels important. You remember Nana's stories of the Whispering Woods. She always said that the forest responds to those who listen with an open heart. A thrill of anticipation courses through you. This is more than just a camping trip; it's an invitation.

The glow from the healthy lumiflora seems to beckon you forward, while the sickly patch hums with a quiet warning. Do you dare venture into the heart of the Whispering Woods to investigate the strange light and the ailing flowers, or do you check back with your family at the campsite?
segment.image_description: A 14-year-old waking up in a sleeping bag in a forest clearing at twilight, with glowing flowers nearby.
segment.title: Lumiflora's Light

state.current_goal: Investigate the strange light and sickly flowers
